# `hor2min.dec()` {#fn-hor2min-dec}

A05 recovered a limiting sightline within the southern search sector on a synthetic skyline with an interior trough. [A05 results](a05-solar-limits.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-hor2min-dec)

```{=html}
<p>Terrain relief can shift the limiting sightline away from the meridian. The function
samples bearings at 0.01-degree spacing within the specified half-width around 180
degrees. It calls az2dec at each bearing with the stored horizon, or with the supplied
latitude and constant altitude, then returns the minimum sampled declination. A limited
search sector may miss a more extreme sightline elsewhere.
</p>
```

[Sensitivity to the sampled skyline](fn-hor2alt.qmd).


<details><summary>Implementation arguments, return value and documented modes</summary>

```{=html}
<table><thead><tr><th>Argument</th><th>Formal default</th><th>Behaviour in this interface</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><code>hor</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Either a <em>skyscapeR.horizon</em> object or the latitude of the place.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>alt</code></th><td><code>0</code></td><td><p>Altitude of the horizon at southernmost point. Only necessary if no
<em>skyscapeR.horizon</em> object is provided. Default is 0.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>range</code></th><td><code>25</code></td><td><p>Range of azimuths to check for minimum declination. Default is 25
degrees either side of South</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h5>Return value</h5><p>One numeric value in degrees, the smallest declination sampled across the specified azimuth range around south.
</p>
```

</details>
